_icons.{major-ability}: Major Ability marker; abilities tagged with it on the card are Major Abilities
_icons._typeIcon: All Spirit cards carry a ghost type icon in the top-right corner

abilities.name: Ghost Orbs
abilities.text: Place 1 {ghost-orbs} (Ghost Orbs) token adjacent to you on the main board. That space counts as Bright. Remove it at the end of the round

abilities.name: Cold Spot
abilities.text: The first time the Adversary Moves onto or adjacent to your space, they must place their Shadow token on the main board on the space they moved on

abilities.name: Energy Transfer
abilities.text: Remove 1 {bright} (Bright) or {dim} (Dim) token from the board. Increase all Investigators' {charge} by 1

abilities.name: Emergency Lights
abilities.text: Place a {dim} (Dim) token on the Zone you are in. Remove it at the end of the round

abilities.name: Clairvoyance
abilities.text: Reveal the {point-of-interest} token from an adjacent point of interest

abilities.name: Ectoplasm
abilities.text: Place 2 {ectoplasm} (Ectoplasm) tokens adjacent to yourself on the main board. If the Adversary Moves onto an {ectoplasm} token, they cannot use 1 Ability card of your choice next round. Remove the tokens at the end of the current round

abilities.name: Luring Lights
abilities.text: Move 1 adjacent Investigator up to 3 spaces, treating Dark spaces as Dim. Map Hazards retain their effects

abilities.name: True Darkness
abilities.text: Spaces in the Zone you are in cost the Adversary 1 extra {footprint} this round

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.text: It costs the Adversary 1 extra {footprint} the first time they Move onto your space or an adjacent space this round

abilities.name: Mysterious Passage
abilities.text: While you are adjacent to a Map Hazard, Investigators may spend 1 {lungs} to ignore the effects of the Hazard this round

abilities.name: Push
abilities.text: When adjacent to a {point-of-interest}, {objective-item}, {medical-item}, or {evidence} token, you may move that token up to 3 spaces in any direction

abilities.name: Spectral Hand
abilities.text: Take 1 Investigator's Flashlight from the board, move it up to 3 spaces, and reorient it as you see fit
